- Security touchpoint (SOC 2 evidence, data residency) — Neptune Security Ops or contact

1) Tue Aug 25 10:00–11:00
2) Wed Aug 26 15:00–16:00
3) Thu Aug 27 08:30–09:30

If none work, send two options that match your procurement + security owners and we’ll prioritize. I’ve attached a draft SOW and a short security brief so your team can scan before the call.

- List of attendees + roles (procurement, legal, security, infra engineer)
- Any procurement templates (PO terms) you require
- Point of contact for security evidence (SOC 2 point + email)

Attachments: neptune_sow_v1.pdf (draft), redwood-security-brief.pdf
